activation_blockers: Current exchange inventory confirms two non-flat positions.
One close order remains locally acknowledged with unresolved recovery.
LIVE depth validity must be checked against natural proposal-to-submit latency before rollout.
deployment.rule: Do not force-close positions, clear safety blockers, or copy the unrelated dirty worktree to the active release.

scope_limitations: The submit status alone is not a validated fill or ledger settlement.
No durable latest venue query error code exists; a specific venue error is not independently established.
Flat-only external-close reconciliation does not repair this non-flat exposure.
No manual order, cancellation, forced state rewrite or restart was performed.

entry_gate: Account-scoped OFF, SHADOW and ENFORCE controls with CAS audit and submission locking.
Explicit LIVE, credential-free, host-budgeted depth GET for otherwise qualified candidates.
Direction-aware final-quantity depth, spread, worst-level impact and price-basis checks.
Independent SANDBOX execution quote spread and freshness veto.
Frozen evidence and control digests shared by replay and S3/TradingView admission.
Re-evaluation using actual order side and quantity before submission; original risk checks retained.
No liquidity dependency added to reduce-only exits or native stop management.
research: Expanding-window, train-only selection with complete non-overlapping out-of-sample folds.
All candidate baselines, configured fees/slippage, cash baseline and open-position disclosure.
Read-only bounded archive runner with per-fold research acceptance and content digests.
Causal Gaussian-HMM forward filtering with immutable model/scaler/feature/timeframe contracts.
Log-domain numerical safeguards and future-prefix invariance checks.
Brier score and reliability bins for explicitly observed binary events, not latent market-state labels.
Evidence-explicit acceptance that never authorizes orders or automatic deployment.

still_not_implemented_or_established: A fitted and independently accepted HMM model, multi-seed state-count selection or live state switching.
Historical arrival-time proof, listing/universe history and complete funding coverage.
Order-book cancellation/OFI/VPIN history or a twenty-day same-session depth baseline.
Model drift monitoring and retraining with stable economic state labels.
A unified persisted research-run dashboard and automatic model publication.
Improved realized profitability, live slippage or real-money acceptance.
